id.judul: Belajar dari Contoh atau Aturan Tetap?
id.instruksi: Baca cara kerja program pada setiap kartu. Seret ke rak belajar dari contoh atau rak aturan tetap.

id.i2: memprediksi video yang disukai dengan belajar dari penilaian penonton

id.i5: membaca tulisan tangan setelah belajar dari huruf tulisan tangan berlabel

id.i7: menebak jenis musik setelah belajar dari lagu yang sudah diberi jenisnya

en.judul: Learns From Examples or Fixed Rules?
en.instruksi: Read how the program works on each card. Drag it to the learns from examples shelf or the fixed rules shelf.
en.i1: recognising a new face after practising with labelled photos of faces
en.i2: predicting favourite videos by learning from viewer ratings
en.i3: writing out new speech after learning from recordings and their transcripts
en.i4: translating a new sentence after learning from examples in two languages
en.i5: reading handwriting after learning from labelled handwritten letters
en.i6: recognising a new flower after learning from photos labelled with flower names
en.i7: predicting a kind of music after learning from songs labelled with their kind
